description_target.target_text: 4 dots form rectangle corners: draw 3x3 blocks (border=opposite color) and dotted gray lines between

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (dots (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))
                           #:when (not (= (cell-at g r c) 0)))
                 (list r c (cell-at g r c))))
         (result (make-hash)))
    (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) 0))
    ;; For each dot, draw 3x3 block
    (for ((dot dots))
      (let* ((dr (first dot)) (dc (second dot)) (color (third dot))
             (other-color
              (for/first ((d dots)
                          #:when (and (= (first d) dr) (not (= (second d) dc))))
                (third d))))
        (for* ((ddr (range -1 2)) (ddc (range -1 2)))
          (let ((nr (+ dr ddr)) (nc (+ dc ddc)))
            (when (and (>= nr 0) (< nr h) (>= nc 0) (< nc w))
              (hash-set! result (list nr nc)
                         (if (and (= ddr 0) (= ddc 0)) color other-color)))))))
    ;; For each pair of dots on the same row, draw dotted horizontal line
    (for ((d1 dots))
      (for ((d2 dots))
        (when (and (= (first d1) (first d2)) (< (second d1) (second d2)))
          (let* ((dr (first d1))
                 (lc (second d1)) (rc (second d2))
                 (mid (/ (+ 0.0 lc rc) 2.0)))
            ;; From left end
            (let loop ((c (+ lc 2)))
              (when (<= (+ c 0.0) mid)
                (hash-set! result (list dr c) 5)
                (loop (+ c 2))))
            ;; From right end
            (let loop ((c (- rc 2)))
              (when (>= (+ c 0.0) mid)
                (hash-set! result (list dr c) 5)
                (loop (- c 2))))))))
    ;; For each pair on same column, dotted vertical line
    (for ((d1 dots))
      (for ((d2 dots))
        (when (and (= (second d1) (second d2)) (< (first d1) (first d2)))
          (let* ((dc (second d1))
                 (tr (first d1)) (br (first d2))
                 (mid (/ (+ 0.0 tr br) 2.0)))
            (let loop ((r (+ tr 2)))
              (when (<= (+ r 0.0) mid)
                (hash-set! result (list r dc) 5)
                (loop (+ r 2))))
            (let loop ((r (- br 2)))
              (when (>= (+ r 0.0) mid)
                (hash-set! result (list r dc) 5)
                (loop (- r 2))))))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

                                                  (!= (second d) dc)))
                                              (third d))))
                 (for* ((ddr (range -1 2)) (ddc (range -1 2)))
                       (let ((nr (+ dr ddr))
                             (nc (+ dc ddc)))
                         (when
                           (and (>= nr 0) (< nr h) (>= nc 0) (< nc w))
                           (hash-set! result
                                      (list nr nc)
                                      (if (and (zero? ddr) (zero? ddc))
                                          color

             (for ((d1 dots))
               (for ((d2 dots))
                 (when

                   (let* ((dr (first d1))

                          ((c (- rc 2)))
                          (when
                            (>= (+ c 0.0) mid)
                            (hash-set! result (list dr c) 5)
                            (loop (- c 2))))))))
             (for ((d1 dots))

                 (when
                   (and (= (second d1) (second d2)) (< (first d1) (first d2)))
                   (let* ((dc (second d1))
